text: Overall the job was good. But the car has some rough patches which refused to go away despite the ceramic coating. Was told by your polisher that the roughness was due to some earlier paint job on my car in which the painter did not cover the rest of the car. He recommends that I send the car for some touch up job at your place so that the rough portions can be grinded with sandpaper and resprayed. He said the cost would be minimal. Will see how it goes when I have the time to do it.
